stories.headline: UK backs Fractile with major funding
stories.summary: The UK government and British Business Bank announced backing for Fractile, a frontier AI hardware firm, in a round worth over £500 million.
stories.why_it_matters: Big public funding for AI chips signals a serious sovereign-compute push.

stories.headline: MIT gets ARPA-H funding for AI herbicides
stories.summary: MIT-led researchers won up to $53 million to build generative AI tools for safer herbicide discovery.
stories.why_it_matters: AI is being used to speed up real-world chemistry and agriculture R&D.

stories.headline: Cornell selects AI thought summits
stories.summary: Cornell chose five interdisciplinary teams for 2026-27 Thought Summits on AI and data science.
stories.why_it_matters: It seeds new cross-campus research on emerging AI questions.
